rows.why: Row-bound and fallible: AUDIT_DIR = BASE_DIR/('hl_live_copy_audit' if FOLLOWER_NETWORK=='mainnet' else f'hl_live_copy_audit_{FOLLOWER_NETWORK}') and acquire_instance_lock(AUDIT_DIR) place lock, state, logs and health file inside the per-network dir, so two networks cannot share a lock or state file; a single shared AUDIT_DIR fails this row and the NET-003 cross-topology rows. Live trees hl_live_copy_audit and hl_live_copy_audit_testnet are separate. LIMIT: artifact ships no harness, so the replay path above is mine.

Row requires certification to follow REAL ACTIVE mainnet leader wallets with no synthetic/self-controlled leader. The only check asserts topology (leader=mainnet, follower=testnet) - NET-003/NET-008 subject - and passes identically for a synthetic mainnet-labelled leader. No leader address, no active-leader read, no third-party-leader fills anywhere; the 11 negatives contain no real-leader control. A check that cannot distinguish a real leader from a self-made one does not test the row.

Row needs (a) no mainnet send without Richard authorisation RECORDED and (b) MAINNET_WRITE_ACTIONS=0. Evidence is one env equality HL_LIVE_AUTO_SEND_ENABLED=0 plus code 'if not auto_send_enabled: return False, MASTER_REAL_ORDERS_OFF'. No authorisation record exists in register or code (flag is env-driven, no authorised-by field) and no write-action counter was measured; the named packet-capture oracle never ran. Product miss, not a tooling fault.

Row is about promotion: exact certified SHA running ON MAINNET. Check only hashes the local file (re-derived identical at fa9d9f55 and fefc2b04), proving single source, not mainnet service. Absent component named exactly: MAINNET SERVING-BUILD BINDING - no mainnet process, deployed-artifact digest or exchange-side identity tied to a mainnet run.

Product miss, proven twice. Register demands per-wallet staleness above HL_LIVE_WS_STALE_MS (30000); the tested commit has zero occurrences of HL_LIVE_WS_STALE_MS - write_health() uses HL_LIVE_WS_SUBSCRIBED_STALE_MS default 4*60*60*1000. Consequence in the live file: wallet 0x1b232b41b0e75550c59288b99874e4a8142fbe21 has stale_ms=7967947 (2.2h silence) and stale=false, which the specified 30s threshold must flag. HEALTH_fa9d9f55ff was already refused as source-substring checks and HEALTH_CORRECTION never covers HEALTH-001. LIMIT: runtime half is a live dir, code default is the reproducible half.

Row-bound with a real mutation pair: AGE_IN_WRITE_PATH (last_copy_poll_age_ms=120018 in SERVICE_STATE_FILE), NEG ZERO_WITHOUT_PRIOR (0), NEG THRESHOLD_FIRES (_entry_sends_blocked_reason=COPY_POLL_STALE), NEG NOT_FIRES (''). The fires/not-fires pair makes it non-vacuous; AGE_* names are specific to this row and would fail for HEALTH-003's send_block_reason probes. Harness committed, replayable.

Row-bound: SEND_BLOCK_REASON_IN_STATE observed send_block_reason=MASTER_REAL_ORDERS_OFF in SERVICE_STATE_FILE with its own negative SEND_BLOCK_REASON_EMPTY_WHEN_ENABLED ('' when enabled), so the predicate can fail. Fields are distinct from HEALTH-002 - swapping the two rows' evidence breaks both.

Mislabelled. Row requires local failure isolation: one bad wallet/symbol/API response blocks only that key, the five account-wide hazards being the only global stops. The two checks only show network_errors increments (1) and is 0 on success - a counter that cannot distinguish per-key from global blocking. No per-key block induced, no sibling key shown still trading, the five global stops never enumerated.

rows.why: Confirmed: no probe runs certification/UI/Graphify/watchdog/repo diagnostics alongside a legitimate execution delta to show the delta still lands. All 10 checks in the correction artifact inspected - none touches diagnostics-vs-execution. Absent probe, not a tooling fault; exact gap named.

Carried boilerplate. Recomputed check-name sets over all 53 rows: sets differ only because each row renames checks[0]; the other 23 checks are identical in every row (FOUR_LEG_PROOF, GATE0/1/2_PASS, ...). The one row-named check AUTHORITY_IS_LOGICAL_ROLE_PROVENANCE has detail 'Gate0: BINDING_AUTHORITY=PASS' - a pointer, not a probe. The row oracle (git log of origin/control-mailbox with exact SHAs + consumer receipt) is never joined to I1; no I1 envelope or receipt cited.

ONE_CANONICAL_PROJECT_ROLE_CHANNEL = 'Gate0: BINDING_AUTHORITY=PASS proves canonical channel' - a restatement of the row, with no channel list and no proof a second channel is absent. The other 23 checks are byte-identical across all 53 control rows, so none can be row-bound to I2.

GIT_IS_DURABLE_TRUTH = 'All evidence on origin/control-mailbox branch; chat is interface only' - a summary sentence with no SHA, path or re-derivable command. Supporting checks are the 23 carried ones; the row's git-log + durable-receipt oracle is never exercised.

EVENT_PUSH_IS_NORMAL_DELIVERY_TRIGGER = 'Control-mailbox uses event-push delivery; no polling' - architectural assertion; the discriminating negative (delivery without a push, or a poll-only path failing) is absent. Remaining 23 checks carried identically across 53 rows.

Vacuous predicate. Detail 'git fetch proves remote ref; fetch failure would detect absence' describes what WOULD happen and never runs the absence case. Probed the cited mailbox commit 8dbb947ee726f1cda818fc346ecfc257195be686: it EXISTS with 275 control_mailbox paths (tip 97d8e35 has 282), so the absence branch is untested.

The exact distinction this project has burned itself on is discharged by 'Gate0: BINDING_AUTHORITY=PASS proves semantic consumption' - a pointer. The discriminating probes (deposit without consumer receipt reads NOT_CONSUMED; delivered-but-unread must not read CONSUMED) are absent from artifact and mailbox. Remaining 23 checks carried across all 53 rows.
